from collections import defaultdict, Counter
def solve(gi,go):
    bg=gi[0][0]; H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cs=comps(gi,bg)
    singles=[(cl[0][0],cl[0][1],gi[cl[0][0]][cl[0][1]]) for cl in cs if len(cl)==1]
    multi=[[(x,y) for x,y in cl] for cl in cs if len(cl)>1]
    outs=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for rr,cc,v in singles:
        cands=[]
        for T in multi:
            tv=[t for t in T if gi[t[0]][t[1]]==v]
            if not tv: continue
            for t in tv:
                cnt=sum(go[rr+(x-t[0])][cc+(y-t[1])]==gi[x][y] for x,y in T if 0<=rr+x-t[0]<H and 0<=cc+y-t[1]<W)
                cands.append((cnt,(t,T)))
        _,chosen=max(cands)
        (tt,T)=chosen[1]
        for x,y in T:
            ni,nj=rr+(x-tt), cc+(y-tt)
            if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and outs[ni][nj]==bg:
                outs[ni][nj]=gi[x][y]
    return outs
for p in (3,4):
    sol=solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    diff=[(r,c,sol[r][c],G[f'Demo pair {p} output'][r][c]) for r in range(len(sol)) for c in range(len(sol[0])) if sol[r][c]!=G[f'Demo pair {p} output'][r][c]]
    print('demo',p,'ndiff',len(diff),diff[:6])

G=load()
from collections import Counter
def analyze(p):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    bg=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    seen=set(); cs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if gi[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; cc={(r,c)}; seen.add((r,c))
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop()
                    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and (a,b) not in seen and gi[a][b]==gi[r][c]:
                            seen.add((a,b)); cc.add((a,b)); st.append((a,b))
                cs.append(cc)
    big=max(cs,key=len); sc=gi[next(iter(big))[0]][next(iter(big))[1]]
    S=list(big); others=[(r,c,v) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) for v in [gi[r][c]] if gi[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in S]
    r0=min(r for r,c in S); c0=min(c for r,c in S)
    patS=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in S]
    res=[]
    for ar,ac,v in others:
        sh=[]
        for dr in range(-H,H):
            for dc in range(-W,W):
                top=(ar+dr,ac+dc)
                if any(not(0<=top[0]+o<H and 0<=top[1]+p<W) for o,p in patS): continue
                if any(go[top[0]+o][top[1]+p]!=sc for o,p in patS): continue
                # exclude template cells themselves from hit count? just raw count of non-bg
                nn=sum(1 for o,p in patS if gi[top[0]+o][top[1]+p]!=bg)

        res.append(((ar,ac,v),sorted(sh)))
    return bg,sc,S,others,res

G=load()
from collections import Counter
def solve(p):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    bg=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    def comps_same(g,bg):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for r in range(len(g)):
            for c in range(len(g[0])):
                if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                    v=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp={(r,c)}; seen.add((r,c))
                    while st:
                        x,y=st.pop()
                        for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                            if 0<=a<len(g) and 0<=b<len(g[0]) and (a,b) not in seen and g[a][b]==v:
                                seen.add((a,b)); comp.add((a,b)); st.append((a,b))
                    out.append((v,comp))
        return out
    cc_=comps_same(gi,bg); best=max(cc_,key=lambda t:len(t[1])); S=list(best[1]); sc=best[0]
    others=[(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in S]
    r0=min(r for r,c in S); c0=min(c for r,c in S)
    patS=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in S]
    placed=set()
    stamps=set()
    for ar,ac,av in others:
        done=False
        for dr in range(-H,H):
            for dc in range(-W,W):
                top=(ar+dr,ac+dc)
                cells=set((top[0]+o,top[1]+p) for o,p in patS)
                if any(not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) for x,y in cells): continue
                ok=all(go[x][y]==sc or (x,y) in placed for x,y in cells)
                if len(cells&placed)==0 and ok:
                    stamps|=cells; placed|=cells; done=True; break
            if done: break
    mismatch=sum(1 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if go[r][c]!=(sc if (r,c) in stamps else gi[r][c]))
    print(f'demo{p}: anchors={len(others)} stamps={len(stamps)} expected_stamps={sum(1 for x in go if x==sc)-len(S)} mismatches={mismatch}')
    return mismatch==0
results=[solve(p) for p in range(1,9)]
print(results)
